questions.question: What is LOP?
questions.answer: Unpaid leave days used to work out paid days for salary.

questions.question: What is PF?
questions.answer: Provident Fund contribution recorded in payroll, based on the applicable PF wage and rule.

questions.question: What is EPF?
questions.answer: The provident fund part of the employer contribution after the pension share.

questions.question: What is EPS?
questions.answer: The pension share of the employer's PF contribution.

questions.question: What is TDS?
questions.answer: Tax deducted through payroll in monthly parts toward expected yearly tax.

questions.question: What are salary arrears?
questions.answer: The difference between revised earned salary and what was actually paid for past periods.

questions.question: What is Gratuity?
questions.answer: A settlement payment that applies only when an employee meets the company eligibility rule.

questions.question: What is leave encashment?
questions.answer: An amount for eligible unused leave, worked out under the company's recorded settings.

questions.question: What is notice recovery?
questions.answer: An amount recoverable for unserved notice when recorded terms permit it and the notice was not waived.

questions.question: Why did my take-home pay change?
questions.answer: Your take-home pay changes when recorded earnings or deductions change, such as from unpaid leave, revised statutory PF ceilings, salary revisions, or tax differences. The assistant leads with the net change amount and lists the main recorded reasons.

questions.question: Can HCM One predict my pay for next month?
questions.answer: The assistant explains only recorded months and cannot promise next month's pay. Upcoming pay depends on that month's recorded inputs and applicable rules.

questions.question: Why is my bank deposit different from my payslip?
questions.answer: The assistant can use only your payroll records and cannot check your bank credit. If your bank credit differs from your payslip, the assistant can help you draft a query for HR.

questions.question: What does Incomplete mean?
questions.answer: A required record or input is missing, so the full total cannot be shown yet. Known parts of your pay can still be shown.

questions.question: What does Cannot explain from available payroll data mean?
questions.answer: The available payroll records don't explain the difference, or you've disputed the result. The assistant can help you draft a query for HR.

questions.question: Can the assistant recommend which tax regime I should choose?
questions.answer: The assistant can explain the tax recorded in your payroll, but cannot recommend a tax regime or investment. Please consult a tax professional for personal advice.

questions.question: Why did my monthly TDS deduction increase?
questions.answer: Monthly TDS increases when declared income, such as from a previous employer, is added to your yearly income, increasing expected yearly tax. The tax already deducted by your previous employer is credited so it is not deducted twice.

questions.question: How does the payroll query process work?
questions.answer: The assistant prepares a draft with your description and relevant payslip evidence for you to review and confirm. Once sent, HR reviews the issue and records a resolution, which you can accept or dispute.

questions.question: What do the query statuses mean?
questions.answer: Draft is not sent. Sent means HR can access it for review. In review means HR has taken it for review. Resolved means HR recorded a resolution and you can dispute it. Closed requires an explicit closure action and its history is kept.

questions.question: Can the assistant send a query to HR without my confirmation?
questions.answer: No. The assistant prepares a draft with your description and evidence, but will send it only after you explicitly confirm.

questions.question: Does approving a proposal mean payment is made?
questions.answer: No. Approving records that version and selected items as ready for payroll. It does not apply the change or make a payment.

questions.question: Can the AI assistant approve a payroll change?
questions.answer: No. The assistant prepares calculations and explains records, but cannot approve a change, apply it or pay it. Every salary change requires explicit approval by authorized HR.

questions.question: What happens if a proposal is edited after review?
questions.answer: Editing creates a revised version. HCM One rechecks affected amounts and totals, and authorized HR must review the new version before approving.

questions.question: What does Complete for this scope mean?
questions.answer: All needed records and verified rules were available for that result. It does not mean HR has approved it or that anything has been paid.

questions.question: What does Rule not verified mean?
questions.answer: A required rule, version, source, or effective date is missing or not verified. That part of the calculation is blocked until the rule is verified.

questions.question: What does an applicable due date mean in a settlement?
questions.answer: An applicable due date is the recorded target deadline for that specific settlement component under policy or statutory rules. It does not mean the assistant has made a payment.

questions.question: Can pending asset clearance hold my earned salary?
questions.answer: A pending clearance never holds the final salary; only the related asset recovery line stays unresolved until the clearance is confirmed.

questions.question: How long can exiting employees access settlement information in HCM One?
questions.answer: Your settlement statement and query features remain accessible in HCM One while you still have access. Delivery after your last working day happens through the company exit process.

questions.question: Can employees see other people's salary or tax details?
questions.answer: No. You can only see your own data. The assistant refuses requests to view other people's records and never confirms or denies anything about another person's salary, tax or records.

questions.question: Are personal identification numbers visible in the assistant?
questions.answer: No. Bank account numbers, permanent account numbers, and other identification numbers are never shown in full.

questions.question: What is HCM One and what data does it use?
questions.answer: HCM One is an AI payroll assistant that explains payroll records and prepares proposals and query drafts for human review. It runs on fictional company mock data using simplified rules.

questions.question: What is basic pay?
questions.answer: Basic pay is the core component of salary and forms part of the provident fund wage alongside dearness allowance.

questions.question: What is HRA?
questions.answer: House Rent Allowance is a salary earnings component that adjusts with attendance and general salary revisions.

questions.question: What is special allowance?
questions.answer: Special allowance is an additional earnings component paid each month based on paid calendar days.

questions.question: What is DA?
questions.answer: Dearness allowance is a salary component that is counted alongside basic pay to determine the provident fund wage.

questions.question: What is the difference between gross and net pay?
questions.answer: Gross pay is the total of all earned salary components before deductions, while net pay is the final take-home amount after deducting provident fund and tax.

questions.question: What is employer PF contribution?
questions.answer: Employer provident fund contribution is the matching share paid by the company, divided between the employee pension share and provident fund.
